stories.title: Consent Persistence and Storage Policy Enforcement
stories.description: Implement persistence rules ensuring Tier 1 data is never stored in identifiable form and Tier 2 data is stored only after explicit consent, including database write guards and validation hooks.

stories.title: Consent Audit Logging and Traceability
stories.description: Implement audit logs capturing consent decisions, tier transitions, timestamps, and enforcement actions to support compliance and traceability.

stories.title: Consent Downgrade and Data Purge Handling
stories.description: Implement logic to handle downgrade from Tier 2 to Tier 1, including purging or de-identifying previously stored identifiable data in compliance with HIPAA Safe Harbor.

stories.title: Cross-Service Consent Enforcement Integration
stories.description: Integrate consent enforcement checks across all domain services (find care, evaluate care, unknowns, lead capture) to ensure no service bypasses consent rules.
